q: How does a re-rolling mill in Sihor work out CO2 per tonne of bars?
title: Sihor re-rolling mill: CO2 per tonne
short: Count fuel burnt in the reheating furnace, coal, furnace oil or gas, times its factor, and electricity for the rolling stands, divided by tonnes of bars or sections. Ship plate feed carries little or no embedded emissions under the CBAM transitional rules; check the definitive-period act before quoting that.
audience: Re-rolling mills around Sihor and Bhavnagar using ship plate

ul: Electricity for rolling (recorded, not charged for steel under CBAM).
Tonnes of plate charged and bars produced.

p: Bars, rods and sections are CBAM goods. An EU importer needs your figure or uses the default value.

example.title: Worked example
lines: Coal in furnace: 75 kg per tonne of bars x 2.42 kg = 182 kg CO2
Electricity: 110 kWh x 0.710 kg = 78 kg CO2 (Scope 2)
Direct figure for CBAM: about 0.18 t CO2 per tonne
